_comment: The fake Linux every demo host opens. {home}, {user}, {hostname} and {alias} are filled in per host. Read-only.

files.{home}/notes.txt:
Welcome to {hostname}.

This server is part of Flint's demo: nothing here is real, and
every demo host shows the same files. Things to try:

  ls -l app        list a folder
  cat app/README   read a file
  uptime           a remote command
  exit             back to your machine
files.{home}/app/README:
app: a small web service.
Deployed with `flint exec {alias} -- app/deploy.sh` from a laptop,
without anyone copying a password around.
